notes.title: Update 1: Oculus Rift support, FPS controls+UI and VR interactions update!
notes.content:
[h1][b][u]Update 1 for "The Day They Landed" is live now. Patch notes are below: [/u][/b][/h1]

[olist]
[*] Added Oculus Rift support for the game. (Some Oculus users might experience black lines on the desktop screen while playing. We are working on that.)
[*] Improved first person controls and camera movement. Added a crosshair for the first person for shooting assist.
[*] Added "Teleport Indicator" and "Shooting Assist with Range Indicator" for the VR player.
[/olist]

[h1]Next update will include [spoiler]a new menu and a brand new "Single Player VR Experience"![/spoiler][/h1]
